text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired: rate-capacity anomaly detected for /v1/generate - 429 spikes from 11:12 UTC. Threshold breached: 429_rate > 5% for 5m. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks.net/rlimiter-429

pagerduty-bot: PD Alert  P0 -> contacted on-call: Maya Chen. Incident key: rlimit-1768456789. Escalation policy: RUNTIME -> SRE -> ENG-LEAD.

Maya Chen: I’m on it, reading logs now. tagging @Jae @Priya. Can someone paste recent deploys?

Jae Kim: No deploys in the last 30m from deploy-bot. Looks like a control-plane config push earlier (09:40 UTC) touched quota-mapper.

Priya Nair: Confirming a surge of 429s coincident with quota-mapper config roll (rate caps tightened for some orgs). Running quick query against limiter metrics.

Carlos Ruiz: I see the limiter heartbeat intermittently failing to sync with the distributed tokens. Could be the v2 mapper not returning limits for ~3% of keys.

Maya Chen: Customer impact? any large tenants affected?

Jae Kim: Top affected orgs: acme-inc (12% requests 429), beta-co (5%), several small dev accounts. Overall 10-15% of requests to hosted api were throttled; Dedicated unaffected.

Maya Chen: Ok hold mitigation options: (A) rollback quota-mapper config; (B) temporary bypass (allowlist) for top orgs; (C) increase token bucket capacity on runtime to absorb.

Priya Nair: Suggest do B immediately for observed high-impact tenants + start rollback (A) as safe fallback. We can patch runtime rule within 3-5m.

Carlos Ruiz: I can push bypass for acme-inc and beta-co now. Command I’ll run:

```
# add bypass rule, 5m TTL
redwood-cli rl bypass add --org acme-inc --reason "incident 1768456789" --ttl 300
```

Carlos Ruiz: Running now.

Carlos Ruiz: done. Logs: 
```
bypass:created org=acme-inc ttl=300 id=byp-9f3a
bypass:created org=beta-co ttl=300 id=byp-a1b2
```

Maya Chen: Nice. Priya, please start the rollback of the quota-mapper config. Jae, keep checking limiter heartbeats.

Priya Nair: Initiating rollback to v2026-03-10-rlmap. Rolling in canary then global.

Jae Kim: Heartbeat chatter still shows short gaps but bypass should relieve customers. 429 rate down from 12% -> 2.3% in 4m.

pagerduty-bot: Maya Chen acknowledged the pager (ack by Maya Chen at 11:18 UTC).

Maya Chen: Noted drop in 429s. Keeping incident open to confirm stable for 20m. Notifying support and CS for potential impacted customers. @Sam can you draft a bridge message?

Sam O'Neill: On it. Drafting: 
"We observed a transient rate-limiting event affecting some hosted API requests between 11:12-11:20 UTC. Immediate mitigations applied; customers should see restored service. Teams investigating root cause and will follow up."

Sam O'Neill: Sent to CS channel and queued an email to top affected customers.

Priya Nair: Rollback completed to v2026-03-10-rlmap at 11:22 UTC. Monitoring.

Jae Kim: After rollback, heartbeat stabilized. No new 5xxs. 429s down to 0.5% and trending toward baseline.

Maya Chen: Good. Triage notes so far: config tighten in quota-mapper + intermittent token sync failures in limiter. Hypothesis: new mapper logic dropped keys when cache-miss + NATS flakiness leading to short-lived limiter state issues.

Carlos Ruiz: Filing immediate ticket against quota-mapper change: revert-and-fix branch created. My plan: add more defensive checks for missing keys and retry the mapper lookup.

Maya Chen: Escalate to ENG-LEAD? We should involve runtime and infra for postmortem.

Priya Nair: @Jae can you collect limiter debug traces, include the DB and NATS spans, and upload to the incident folder?

Jae Kim: Collecting traces now, pushing archive to s3://incidents/1768456789/traces.tar.gz

Maya Chen: PD: clearing alert once we confirm stable 20m window. Current status: mitigated, customer impact reduced. Leaving page open for post-incident review.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation halted. Waiting for explicit close by oncall.

Maya Chen: I’ll keep this open and move to postmortem after 24h. Action items:
- Carlos: revert + harden quota-mapper (owner)
- Jae: collect traces & metrics (owner)
- Priya: run canary test harness on mapper change and verify token sync (owner)
- Sam: customer comms + timeline (owner)

Carlos Ruiz: Will open PR and run CI. ETA for fix: 48h.

Jae Kim: Traces uploaded: s3://incidents/1768456789/traces.tar.gz ; graphs updated in dashboards.

Sam O'Neill: Customer comms sent to top affected orgs; support triage ready.

Maya Chen: Thanks team. Closing notes: no data loss, limited to throttling. Root cause hypothesis needs validation: quota-mapper change + transient messaging layer flakiness. Postmortem draft will include timeline and deets.

-- End thread --
